book.name: Mariko
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mariko

content: Yeesu araanga ameegyo ga Abhafarisayo
Orusiku rumwe, Abhafarisayo bharebhe na abheegya bhe emigiro gya Musa bhakarweera Yerusaremu, bhakaaza bhakiikumania ku Yeesu.
Bhakabharora abhaanabheega abhamwe bha Yeesu bhaari bhararya ebhyaakurya bhakyaari kwiisaabha amabhoko kyeego yaari ekweenderwa muziinyaangi zyaabhu.
Abhafarisayo na Abhayahudi bhoosi bhataari bhararya bhakyaari kwiisaabha tee kuzikokora, okuhiita eziisiira zya bhazaazi bhaabhu kyeego zyaari.
Hano bhaarweereeri mumuteera, bhariisaabha hiinga amabhoko kyeego ekweenderwa, niho bhakurya. Kweeki, bharahiita eziisiira zyaabhu eziindi nzaru, kyeego bhahoogya ebhikoombe, ebhihurira ne ebhigiro.

Niho Abhafarisayo na abheegya bhe emigiro gya Musa bhakamubhuurya Yeesu, “Kwaki abhaanabheega bhaazo bhatakutuniirira eziisiira zya bhazaazi bheetu, nawe bhararya bhanyakahiri bhakyaari okwiisaabha amabhoko kyeego ekweenderwa?”
Yeesu akabhakyoora, “Emwe abhabheehi! Taatabhugya akagaamba obhuheene iguru weenyu okuhitira omurooti waaye Isaya,

content.text: nawe eziikoro zyaabhu ziri kure neenye.
kwo okubha bhareegya obhuswaagyo bhwa abhaatu

content: Yeesu akageenderera kubhabhuurira, “Emwe muratiga obhuswaagyo bhwa Taatabhugya, muratuniirira eziinyaangi zya abhaatu.
“Mune eziinzira nzomu zyo okwaanga obhuswaagyo bhwa Taatabhugya, okubha mubhone okutuna eziisiira zyeenyu!
Kwe ekireengyo, Taatabhugya akaswaagya kuhitira ku Musa
kubha, ‘Obhasuuke wuuso na nyoko weenyu.’
Kweeki, akabhuga, ‘Omuutu wowoosi wuno akumutuka wiise kasi nyoko waabhu, areenderwa yiitwe.’
Nawe emwe mureegya, eraabhe omuutu arabhuurira abhiibhuri bhaaye, ‘Ebhigiro bhino niinganagirye okukusakirya, bhibheeri Koribani,’ obhugazuro bhwaku ni saambo yo okumuruusirya Taatabhugya.
Okweegya kweenyu kuyo, kuragirya atasakirya abhiibhuri bhaaye kigiro.
Kweego, muraazeere engʼana ya Taatabhugya, okubha munagye okuhiita eziisiira zyeenyu abheene. Na murakora maaru gano garatuubhana na gano.”
Amabhiihu goosi gararwa mukoro
Yeesu akabhirikira esaango ya abhaatu, akabhabhuurira, “Emwe mwoosi muniitegeerere, na mumenye amangʼana gano nikubhabhuurira!
Kitariho kigiro kino kikumusikira omuutu no okugirya kimukwaarihye. Nawe, gano gakurwa mukoro yo omuutu nigo gakukora omuutu akwaarihwe. [
Wa amatwi, yiitegeerere kisi.]”
Hano yatigiri esaango ya abhaatu no okusikira munyuumba, abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakamubhuurya iguru ye ekireengyo kiyo.
Akabhabhuurira, “Naabhe emwe mutana amangʼeeni go okumenya ekireengyo kirya? Mutamenyiri kubha ekigiro kino kikumusikira omuutu kitakunagya okugirya kimukwaarihye?
Ebhyaakurya bhitakusikira mukoro, nawe bhirasikira muunda no okurwa mumubhiri.” Kwo okugaamba ego, Yeesu akeerekya kubha, ebhyaakurya bhyoosi bhiikiririibhwe okurya.
Akageenderera okugaamba, “Gano gakurwa mukoro yo omuutu, nigo gakugirya omuutu kubha makire.
Mukoro yo omuutu, nimwe gakurwa amiiseego mabhiihu, obhutuungiri,
obhwiibhi, obhwiiti, obhuseebheeti, enaamba ye ebhigiro, obhubhi, obhungʼeenererya, amangʼana ge eziisoni, omugono, amatuki, ekisiraani no obhugeege.
Amabhi goosi gano gakurwa mukoro yo omuutu nigo gakugirya abhe makire.”
Obhwiikirirya bhukuru bhwo omukari wumwewuno atari Omuyahudi

Yeesu na abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakatanura Gariraaya, bhakagya emigye gya Tiro na Sidooni. Akiikara munyuumba ngʼania, ateendiri omuutu wowoosi amenye ari hayo. Nawe abhaatu bhakamenyeekererya ari hayo.

Eyo, yaari ariyo omukari wumwe wuno ataari Omuyahudi, nawe yaari Omufoinike. Yaarweereeri Foinike mukyaaro kya Siria. Omuukya waaye yaari ne eriisaambwa eriibhi. Hano omukari wuyo yiigwiiri kubha Yeesu ari haguhi, akaaza ku Yeesu, akahigama embere waaye. Akamusabha amuruusye omwaana waaye eriisaambwa.
Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Etari bhuzomu kugega ebhyaakurya bhya abhaana no okuzirekerera eziimbwa.”
Nawe omukari wurya akamukyoora, “Omukuru, amangʼana gaazo ni ge eheene. Nawe, abhaana hano bhakurya, naabhe eziimbwa nazyo zirarya amasaagyo gano gakutoondobhoka haasi okurwa kwiigari.”
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Hayo ogaambiri bhuzomu. Ambe, noogye, eriisaambwa rimurwiiriku omuukya waazo.”
Omukari wurya akakyoora yiika waaye, akabhona omwaana ahoriri, amuunyiri kubhuriri, ne eriisaambwa rimurwiiriku.
Yeesu arahorya omuribhi wa amatwi
Niho Yeesu akatanura na abhaanabheega bhaaye Tiro, akahita Sidooni, akakyoora ku Nyaanza ya Gariraaya, mukyaaro kya Dekapoori.
Eyo yaari ariyo omuutu wumwe, wuno yaari omuribhi wa amatwi ne eriimuumu. Abhaatu bharebhe bhakamureeta ku Yeesu, bhakamusabha Yeesu amutuurire amabhoko, amuhorye.
Yeesu akamuruusya musaango ya abhaatu, akagya nawe omweene kibhezo. Akatuura ebhyaara bhyaaye mumatwi go omuutu wurya. Akakitweera ekyaara kyaaye amate, akamuhaka kururimi.
Akarora kwiisaaro, akiikya omwiika, akamubhuurira, “Efata,” obhugazuro bhwaku, “Iguka.”
Hayohayo, omuutu wurya akaribhuka amatwi no orurimi, akataanga okwiigwa no okugaamba bhuzomu.
Yeesu akakumiirirya esaango ya abhaatu, bhatamubhuurira muutu wowoosi gano akoriri. Nawe kyeego akageenderera kubharekya, niigo bhakaraarika amangʼana gayo bhukongʼu.
Bhakaruguura bhukongʼu, bhakabhuga, “Goosi gano akoriri ni mazomu. Arahorya abharibhi bha amatwi, bhiigwe, na amamuumu, gagaambe!”

footnotes.text: a Musa. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
b Rora Okurwa 20:12; Obhuhiiti bhwe Emigiro 5:16.
Kugega ebhyaakurya bhya abhaana no okuzirekerera eziimbwa, obhugazuro bhwaku ni kubha Abhayahudi bhabhone obhusakiribhwa hiinga bhakyaari okubhona abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi.
